text:
maya: quick q — when someone saves a ‘preset’ from the per-route view, should the default scope be the route or the model? trying to avoid surprise overwrites :thinking_face:

sam: +1 this. most people expect it to be 'route' since they came from the route page. but we have edgecases where route maps 1:many to models (eg. multi-model routes).

ana: real-world note — customers expect reusability. if they save on a route that's basically a model pin, they get duplicated presets everywhere. painful to clean up.

priya: proposal: default to route-scope for saves from route UI, but show a one-line confirmation banner: "Saved as route preset — make this available to model-level views?" with quick toggle.

luke: UX nit: that banner needs an affordance to change ownership later (transfer to org or model) without re-creating. otherwise ops will have to migrate.

maya: sounds reasonable. API question: what does the savedquery object look like? i sketched something:
```json
{
  "id": "sq_...",
  "name": "High latency 50p",
  "scope": "route", // one of [route, model, org]
  "route_id": "r_...",
  "model_id": null,
  "filters": {...}
}
```

sam: prefer explicit `owner_type` + `owner_id` instead of scope string. it aligns with our ACL model. e.g. `{ owner_type: 'route', owner_id: 'r_123' }`. less special-casing.

priya: agree with sam — also lets us add `public` flag + `shared_with` list later.

ana: telemetry + quota question: when a route preset is used in a model view, do we count it against the route's savedquery quota? we should be careful not to double-charge owners.

maya: good catch. my thought: usage attribution follows the owner. if owner_type==route then it consumes from route's savedquery quota regardless of UI surface that invoked it. keeps accounting simple.

luke: downside: lots of org-level presets could bloat route quotas for small teams. maybe have a fallback where org-owned presets count against org quotas, not route.

priya: implementer note — need to surface quota breakdown in console when a team tries to save: "This workspace has X/10 route presets remaining". show which owner is charged.

sam: rollout plan: default behavior stays same. new `owner_type` field is optional for backward compat. after rollout, console will start offering the banner and toggle. we'll run canary in 10% accounts. @rollout-bot can you schedule canary?

rollout-bot: scheduled canary rollout for `presets-ownership` feature at 2024-07-18T14:00:00Z to 10% of orgs. monitoring: preset-save-rate, quota-errors, ui-errors.

maya: followups: priya and sam to draft the banner copy + API contract. ana to run a quick migration script plan for existing presets without owner_type. let's sync friday 10am. :calendar:

sam: saving notes here — track telemetry events: `preset.save`, `preset.scope.change`, `preset.applied_in_view` with fields `owner_type`, `invoking_surface` (route|model|console).

ana: i'll add a couple of sample queries for the alerting playbook (spike in `preset.save` errors, sudden ownership transfers).

priya: ok will draft UX mocks and share in the thread.

maya: thanks all — this should cut down duplicated presets and make quotas clearer.
